note: Michele Wilder answers — practical guidance, with pricing and diary details confirmed directly.

items.q: I've never done HYROX — can I join?
items.a: Yes — that's exactly who Michele's Foundations programme and the Hyrox Newbies community are for. You don't need a race booked to start training.
8km of running split by 8 workout stations — SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jumps, rowing, farmers carry, sandbag lunges and wall balls. Same format worldwide.
Michele is based around Maidstone in Kent and coaches online UK-wide. The Hyrox Newbies community runs nationally.
Confirmed dates sit on the Race Calendar & Travel page, sourced from the official HYROX listings.

items.q: Can you find me a doubles partner?
items.a: Use Find a Race-mate to post your division and pace. Michele runs a 70,000-strong HYROX community, so matchmaking is home turf.

items.q: What training options and prices are available?
items.a: HYROX coaching with Michele — enquire for current terms. Read the Coaching page for each offer's format and its official link. The provider sets current prices and terms.
Choose the offer that fits your goal on the Coaching page, then follow its own official button. Use Ask if you want to discuss your starting point first.

items.q: Where are the partner links and codes?
items.a: The Partners page lists Wilder Fitness UK, HYROX Newbies, Michele's HYROX coach profile. Check the linked provider for current eligibility and terms.
